company.name: Toast
company.one_line: Point-of-sale and restaurant management platform, sold to restaurants and retail, used in 180,000 locations.

features.name: Point of sale
features.does: Takes orders and payments on Toast hardware built for busy service.

features.name: Offline mode
features.does: Keeps serving customers when the internet drops.

features.name: Kitchen display system
features.does: Puts every order from every channel in one place for the kitchen.

features.name: Labor management
features.does: Payroll, remote clock-in and tip distribution.

features.name: Toast IQ
features.does: AI assistant that forecasts sales and suggests labor and menu changes.

features.name: Marketing
features.does: SMS, email, loyalty and gift cards.
